description: Runs a fixture-backed Web platform semantics probe for IndexedDB index combined with IDBKeyRange and count(): count(lowerBound) tally + getAllKeys(bound) in index order. The scripted CDP driver observes page output from the self-hosted fixture `/v2/idb/index_range_count`, and the server-side grader compares it against the Chrome-baked expected answer. The answer is computed only by executing the IndexedDB operation (it is not present in the static resource); the DB name is isolated per attempt via the `db` query param.
title: IndexedDB index count over key range
